Is there a Hostinger coupon code? | The Black Friday page we read lists the offer as automatic and shows no code. Check Hostinger's page on the day you buy.
When does the Hostinger Black Friday offer end? | The page we read says 14 December 2026. It started on 19 October.
How much is Hostinger with the Black Friday offer? | Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term, with $95.52 due today. Unlimited is $2.79 and Cloud Startup is $7.99.
What does Hostinger cost after the offer? | Premium renews at $10.99 a month, Unlimited at $16.99 and Cloud Startup at $25.99.
